RAJYA SABHA
Wednesday, the 1st February, 2017/12th Magha, 1938 (Saka)
The House met at thirty minutes past one of the clock,  
MR. CHAIRMAN  in the Chair. 
THE BUDGET GENERAL, 2017-18
MR. CHAIRMAN: The Union Budget, 2017-18. Shri Arun Jaitley.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I beg to lay on the Table, a statement  
(in English and Hindi) of the estimated receipts and expenditure of the Government 
for the year 2017-18.  [Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 6242/16/17]
FISCAL POLICY STATEMENTS, 2017-18
MR. CHAIRMAN: Fiscal Policy Statements, 2017-18.
THE MINISTER OF FINANCE AND THE MINISTER OF CORPORATE 
AFFAIRS (SHRI ARUN JAITLEY): Sir, I beg to lay on the Table, under sub-section 
(1) of Section 3 of the Fiscal Responsibility and Budget Management Act, 2003, a 
copy each (in English and Hindi) of the following papers:-
(i) Macro-Economic Framework Statement;
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 6243/16/17]
(ii) Medium-term Fiscal Policy Statement; and
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 6244/16/17]
(iii) Fiscal Policy Strategy Statement.
[Placed in Library. See No. L.T. 6245/16/17]
MR. CHAIRMAN: The House stands adjourned till 11.00 a.m. on Thursday, the 
2nd of February, 2017.
The House then adjourned at thirty-two minutes past
one of the clock till eleven of the clock on 
Thursday, the 2nd February, 2017.
